g.text: Registry beneficiary names are shown as published, with two repairs (clean_owner in pipeline/build.py):
4,560 names exported with Mac Roman mojibake (e.g. "Societ√† Benefit") are decoded back to UTF-8 ("Società
Benefit"), and statements such as "Retired on behalf of easyJet for aviation emissions period ..." are reduced to the
named party ("easyJet"). Names are then normalized (case, punctuation, legal suffixes) to group retirements. Result:
